# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Ruby Gillis is a fair young woman known for her showy looks, which feature a brilliant complexion and a plump figure. She has large, bright-blue eyes and lovely, long golden hair that she wears in a yellow braid.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby Gillis is a cheerful and good-tempered individual who enjoys the pleasant things in life, though she is prone to hysterics in stressful situations. She harbours a mortal dread of fat green caterpillars. Highly focused on romance, her primary ambitions include having numerous suitors, getting a beau by the age of fifteen, and getting married after teaching for just two years.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## History

Ruby Gillis was known for having successfully charmed away all her warts using a magic pebble given to her by old [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md) from the Creek. As a student in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), she joined [Anne](../character/anne.md) Shirley's story club alongside classmates like [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) to help cultivate their imaginations. When Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) organized an advanced class to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination, Ruby became one of the pupils who joined to study for the test. She later moved to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) to attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside her fellow [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) peers. During her time at Queen's, Ruby regularly visited Anne's boarding house room with other classmates, where they shared news and discussed their academic ambitions.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. >
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013)
